- **Run once per system version (left).** The **Eval set** feeds the **Async runner**, a worker pool whose per-case timeout cancels a hung call. It runs every case through the **System under test** and hands each case's trace to the **Run store** the moment the case finishes.
- **ModelClient and Providers (left, bottom).** Every model call passes the same stages in order: **quota circuit** (fail fast once the quota is spent), **response cache** (an exact repeat costs nothing), **single flight** (identical calls in flight share one), **AIMD limiter** (one shared RPM and TPM budget, cut on a 429) and **jitter retry** (Retry-After when the server sends one, otherwise full-jitter backoff). The **Providers** (a stdlib OpenAI-compatible core; Gemini, OpenAI and Anthropic as optional extras) make one attempt each. Against the local rate-limited fake server, the worker pool ran the suite {{bench.concurrent.speedup|.1f}}x faster than sequential calls with {{bench.concurrent.n_failed}} failed cases.
- **Evaluate stored traces, never re-run (right).** The **Run store** keeps `manifest.json` and `traces.jsonl`, which can be exported to or ingested from **OpenTelemetry** GenAI spans. The **Evaluator** scores those stored traces (metrics, trajectories, judges, failure taxonomy) without calling the system again.
- **Statistical gate (right, bottom).** Cases are paired by id, and a change beyond tolerance counts only when a paired bootstrap or McNemar test supports it at the raw p; Holm-adjusted p is reported, not used. v3 is blocked (groundedness {{cmp.v3.groundedness.baseline|.1f}} to {{cmp.v3.groundedness.candidate|.1f}}) and v2 passes (Recall@3 {{cmp.v2.retrieval_recall_at_3.baseline|.2f}} to {{cmp.v2.retrieval_recall_at_3.candidate|.2f}}). The result goes to the **HTML report**, a per-case diff, and the **PR check**, which keeps one sticky comment up to date.
